title: Real World Assets reach Sky through Arranged Structures whose Conduit is owned by one accountable Agent
content:
A.3.4 states the premise: RWAs "are enforced through legal recourse by Arranged Structures and present unique risks that this Article must address." A.3.4.1 defines them as "special legal structures set up by Ecosystem Actors to secure Real World Assets," each with "a Conduit system which is owned by an Agent and automatically connected to all Agents; the Conduit allows them to send and receive USDS or other assets."

The architecture separates three things that are easy to conflate: the *legal* vehicle that makes an offchain claim enforceable, the *onchain* Conduit through which value moves, and the *ownership* that decides how the Conduit is used. Universal connectivity plus single ownership is the interesting combination — every Agent is technically wired to every Arranged Structure, but A.3.4.2 gives the owner exclusive authority: the Agent owner "assigns instructions to the Arranged Structure on behalf of Sky, and determines if and how other Agents can access the Conduit."

So access is permissioned at the policy layer rather than at the plumbing layer. A new Agent needs no integration work to use an existing RWA structure, only the owner's consent — which makes RWA capacity shareable across the ecosystem while keeping exactly one party answerable for each structure's operation.

A.3.4.4 makes that ownership consequential rather than nominal: "The Agent owner of the Arranged Structure can change the blockchain account of the Arranged Structure and change the Arranger." The owner can redirect where assets flow and replace the specialist operating the structure, without a governance process. The offchain relationship is held at will, so the party that suffers from a bad Arranger is also the party that can remove one.

The reason this matters for the rest of the Stability Scope is that Legal Recourse Assets receive dramatically reduced capital charges (A.3.2.2.1.2.4.2) on the strength of recourse being real. Arranged Structures are the machinery that is supposed to make it real — the legal claim behind the 10% Equivalent Loss figure lives here.
description: Arranged Structures are legal vehicles making RWAs enforceable by recourse; each has a Conduit auto-connected to all Agents, but a single Agent owner instructs it and controls who may access it.
